source_coverage.attribution: reported with source SHA; unsupported plus-one must not count as successful extraction

recall_at_5.numerator: gold relevant passages recovered in top-5 results
recall_at_5.denominator: assessor-annotated relevant gold passages for answerable eligible tasks

citation_precision.denominator: all citations asserted by model in evaluated answerable tasks

source_answer_accuracy.numerator: answers judged supported by gold evidence
source_answer_accuracy.report: counts and adjudicator rationale; no assumed gold from source titles

noninferiority_existing_work.metric: paired accuracy on six C0-control tasks
noninferiority_existing_work.scope: only comparable configurations; not statistical proof

requirements: gold and outcome available in all arms

reversibility.required: baseline source-roster digest, protected query outcomes, and experimental index state restored exactly after withdrawal

scope_limit: Pilot with 24 preregistered prompts; no independent replication or statistical discovery claim.
